description: Interactive: flashcards for a Databricks exam domain (data-engineer-associate, data-engineer-professional, data-analyst-associate, machine-learning-associate, machine-learning-professional, genai-engineer-associate, context-engineer-associate, apache-spark-developer-associate; exam_prep lists the domains) or a chapter, built deterministically from the Field Guide: glossary terms, FAQs and each mapped section's lead sentence. The back of every card is the guide's own sentence with its section URL; a domain the guide doesn't cover says so. Call it when the user says "flashcards for the Data Engineer Associate's governance domain" or "drill me on Unity Catalog terms". In a host that renders MCP Apps the reader turns the cards and marks them Got it or Review again, and can keep a resume code to pick up later (send it back as resume, alone); the text lists every card.

chapter.description: Or a chapter: its slug or URL

domain.description: The exam's domain id, as exam_prep lists them

exam.description: An exam (data-engineer-associate, data-engineer-professional, data-analyst-associate, machine-learning-associate, machine-learning-professional, genai-engineer-associate, context-engineer-associate, apache-spark-developer-associate), with one of its domains

resume.description: A resume code the reader kept from an earlier flashcards (it starts kp1.): picks up where they left off. The code names its own exam domain or chapter, so nothing else is needed.

name: flashcards

front.description: A term, a question or a section's heading

keep.description: For an interactive view: what its Keep my progress button makes a resume code from (scope), and the reader's place when a resume code was sent (resumed). Holds no personal data; nothing is stored on the server.
